item: wh10_design_check_v1 (initial-scope stdlib deterministic design check; no search, no optimisation)
admission: initial scope: frozen <=300 s stdlib probe, single process, <=256 MiB RSS, <=16 MiB output; no numpy/native; PID recorded by the wrapper before compute
purpose: independent pure-Python recomputation of the deterministic gate quantities (bases, anchors, mutations, relaxed anchors, Bloch) of the proposed numpy assay code/rqls_wh10_lm_v1.py, plus Jacobian singular values at the near-anchor (KP) points, before freezing its gates
wrapper: /bin/bash -c 'echo START date PID $$ PGID; exec /usr/bin/env -i TMPDIR=<lane>/tmp <argv>' (exec keeps the PID)
